newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - ITALY - Friday September 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - ITALY - Friday September 13.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in Italy's leading newspapers.
*Secessionis Northern League leader Umberto Bossi sets out on a three-day journey along the northern Po river with the ultimate aim in proclaiming a "Republic of Padania" in Italy's rich north.(ALL)

*Union leaders say talks between trades unions and employers over the renewal of contracts in Italy's huge engineering and metalwork sector broke down making strike action on September 27 inevitable.(ALL)

*Chief executive of high tech group Olivetti, Francesco Caio tries to assure stock market watchdog Consob over the future of his struggling loss-making group, but Consob says it want more details and clarity.(ALL)
*President of industry association Confindustria Giorgio Fossa says he is not at war with the government, but simply wants rigorous financial projects. (Il Sole)
*Government passes legislation opening up mobile phone sector and offering third licence for a third manager of a mobile phone service. (Il Sole)
Reuters has not verified these stories and can not vouch for their accuracy.
